info.title: coho-codegen
info.description: Generates a typed content library from your Coho CMS content types.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Fail if the output directory differs from what generate would write.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Write C# for the type model into the output directory.

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Point this library at a Coho project: asks Coho which account and project
a project token is for, and writes them to the config and the token to .env.
--url <url>, --token <token> (or COHO_TOKEN), --ref <tag>, -y to ask nothing.

commands.name: pull
commands.description:
Fetch the type model for the configured ref into the type model file.
Needs COHO_TOKEN, from the environment or a .env beside the config.
--ref <ref> pulls another tag or branch than the config names.
